help: UNIQUE -- No more than 1 enhancement of this type may be slotted by a character.  Enhances the accuracy of a power by {Boost.Attrib.Accuracy.Scale}%, and the to hit debuff potential of a power by {Boost.Attrib.ToHitDebuff.Scale}% and the defense debuff potential and slow ability by {Boost.Attrib.DefenseDebuff.Scale}%.
power_short_helps: Enhances Accuracy and To Hit and Defense DeBuffs and Slows
